claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Among neutral, isolated gas-phase atoms of Al and Si, which has the higher first ionization energy? Si has the higher first ionization energy. Silicon has the higher first ionization energy in this pair. First ionization energy is the energy required to remove the first electron from an isolated gaseous atom.
